newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: SOCCER-VALDERRAMA TO MISS COPA AMERICA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VALDERRAMA TO MISS COPA AMERICA.

text.p: Colombia's veteran captain Carlos Valderrama will miss next month's Copa America to give him a break from soccer, national team coach Hernan Dario Gomez said on Tuesday.
"Valderrama needs a rest," said Gomez, adding that central defender Jorge Bermudez will be left out for the same reason.

Colombian Football Federation officials said that other regulars such as Leonel Alvarez, Freddy Rincon and Faustino Asprilla may also be given a break, although could be brought in if the team reach the final stages of the tournament.
Gomez is likely to use the competition, which will be held in Bolivia, to test younger players.
"We want to win the Copa America but our most immediate and important aim is to qualify for the World Cup," Gomez said.

Colombia are second in the South American World Cup qualifying group but their position looks vulnerable after three successive defeats. They are away to Uruguay immediately before the Copa American and away to Chile just one week after the final.
Their first-round opponents in the Copa America are Brazil, Mexico and Costa Rica.
